label: MARKETING TERM
headline: Brand Awareness
body: Brand awareness is how familiar people are with your business, products, or services.
caption:
Think about how you recognize your favorite coffee shop just by its logo or the color of its cups. That's brand awareness in action! For your own creative work or small business, building brand awareness means making sure people remember you when they need what you offer. It's about consistently showing up and being recognizable. What little things do you do to help people remember your brand? 🤔
